<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\View;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleOutput;

abstract class MeasuredController extends Controller
{
    protected ?ConsoleOutput $consoleOutput = null;

    /**
     * Wrap every action call in performance measurement.
     */
    public function callAction($method, $parameters)
    {
        return $this->measure($method, fn () => parent::callAction($method, $parameters));
    }

    /**
     * Measure wall-clock time for a closure.
     */
    protected function measure(string $label, \Closure $callback): mixed
    {
        $start  = microtime(true);
        $result = $callback();
        $ms     = (microtime(true) - $start) * 1000;

        $this->logExecutionTime($label, $ms);

        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * Profile a sub-action within a controller action.
     */
    protected function measureProfile(string $label, \Closure $callback): mixed
    {
        return $this->measure("profile:{$label}", $callback);
    }

    /**
     * Log execution time with threshold-based severity.
     */
    protected function logExecutionTime(string $label, float $ms): void
    {
        $context = [
            'action'     => $label,
            'ms'         => round($ms, 2),
            'controller' => static::class,
        ];

        if ($ms <= 50) {
            Log::debug('Action timing', $context);
        } elseif ($ms <= 150) {
            Log::info('Action timing', $context);
        } elseif ($ms <= 300) {
            Log::warning('Slow action', $context);
        } else {
            Log::error('Critical slow action', $context);
        }

        // Console output for artisan context
        if ($this->consoleOutput) {
            $tag = $ms > 300 ? 'error' : ($ms > 150 ? 'comment' : 'info');
            $this->consoleOutput->writeln("<{$tag}>[{$ms}ms] {$label}</{$tag}>");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Safely return a view with existence guard.
     */
    protected function safeView(string $viewName, array $data = [])
    {
        if (!View::exists($viewName)) {
            abort(404, "View [{$viewName}] not found.");
        }
        return view($viewName, $data);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Modules\Invoicing\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\MeasuredController;

class InvoiceController extends MeasuredController
{
    public function index()
    {
        $invoices = $this->measureProfile('fetch-invoices', function () {
            return Invoice::with('items')->paginate(25);
        });

        return $this->safeView('invoicing::index', compact('invoices'));
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $this->validateInvoice($request);
        // ...
    }

    protected function validateInvoice(Request $request): array
    {
        return $request->validate([
            'customer_id' => 'required|uuid|exists:customers,id',
            'due_date'    => 'required|date|after:today',
        ]);
    }
}
